Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Fear of Mekhet
Master. Put this card on a ready Justicar or Inner Circle member. Tap that
vampire. During his or her untap phase, that vampire burns 5 blood. If he or
she cannot burn the blood, burn this card and burn that vampire; otherwise,
the card is placed on another IC member of that vampire's controler's
choice; if there are no other ready IC members, burn this card.

- What if there are Lucinde at 5 blood and Arika at 4 ; Fear is put un
Lucinde, who gets tapped and loses 5 blood. Then, it passes to Arika during
the same untap ? What happens then ? Does the Bitch get tapped and burned,
does it wait for the next untap phase ?

- Similarly : Lucinde at 5 and Arika at 6 ; Lucinde burns 5, passes the card
to Arika ; does Arika get tapped when she gets the card ? When does she get
it ? When does she send it back to Lucinde ?

Sorry, never played the thing competitively, and I'm beginning to think it
could be a nice thing (remember Barcelona !! Anarchy Forever !!! Burn the
Inner Circles !!!!). B-)

T.I.A.
--
Orpheus
